purpose: Define discrete, normalized evidence levels so that variant identity authority, document listing authority, portal text authority, and physical byte authority are never conflated.

evidenceLevels.definition: Actual physical document bytes have been downloaded locally, verified for valid file type/structure, and a real cryptographic SHA-256 digest has been computed directly from those bytes.
The official authority portal/webpage returned the authoritative text/table/content that was physically read and verified, but no static downloadable byte file/hash was captured.
The official authority portal public registry/listing proves document existence, title, publication date, and subject classification, but physical content extraction is not yet bound.
The variant, post, cadre, or specialization identity is proven from an exact table row or locator inside a BYTE_VERIFIED or PORTAL_TEXT_VERIFIED official recruitment advertisement.
An official reference or mention exists, but the document or content authority is insufficient for execution.

governanceLaw.NO_CONFLATION: A variant record whose identity is ADVERTISEMENT_ROW_VERIFIED must never be labeled BYTE_VERIFIED unless its specific syllabus bytes are also hashed.
governanceLaw.TRUTHFUL_NULL_HASH: A null SHA-256 is fully valid when the evidence level is legitimately PORTAL_TEXT_VERIFIED, PORTAL_REGISTRY_VERIFIED, or ADVERTISEMENT_ROW_VERIFIED.
governanceLaw.ZERO_SYNTHESIS: Under no circumstances may a synthetic hash, guessed URL, or fabricated filename be created.
